readings.title: 出門的早上 The Early Start

qs.q: Why does he run at the end?

gram.d: 快 + situation + 了 = almost / about to: 快遲到了 nearly late, 快到了 almost there, 快沒電了 nearly dead (battery). The countdown pattern of daily panic.

readings.title: 高鐵上 On the Bullet Train

ch: He fell asleep watching the scenery

gram.d: Doubled V著 + 就…了 = doing X until Y sneaks up: 看著看著就睡著了 — watched and watched and drifted off; 聊著聊著就十二點了 — chatted our way to midnight. Time dissolving in real grammar.

qs.q: What do they do with the spare twenty minutes?
ch: Cool off in the lobby and breathe

gram.d: 提前二十分鐘到 = arrive twenty minutes early. 提前/提早 + how-much + action: 提前一天訂 book a day ahead. Buffer time, grammaticalized — the professional's pattern.

readings.title: 會議進行中 Inside the Meeting

qs.q: Why could he handle the chairman's question?
ch: They had drilled exactly that question

qs.q: What does the handshake line mean?
ch: See you next month in Kaohsiung — the signing

gram.d: 住 as a result-complement = hold firm: 掌握住節奏 lock down the rhythm, 記住 fix in memory, 停住 come to a stop. The verb grabs on and doesn't let go.

readings.title: 南方轉型 The Southern Transformation

qs.q: What is Kaohsiung transforming from and into?
What two pressures accompany the southward shift?
What is the government's stated response?

gram.d: 成 after a verb marks what something becomes: 轉型成科技重鎮 transform into a tech hub, 翻譯成中文 translate into Chinese, 換成現金 convert to cash. The becoming-complement.

dict.py: Nàozhōng xiǎng le, kuài qǐchuáng!
dict.en: The alarm's ringing — up you get!

dict.py: Wǒ jīntiān yào zǎoqǐ.
dict.en: I have to get up early today.

dict.py: Nǐ chūmén le ma?
dict.en: Have you left the house yet?

dict.py: Wǒ chàdiǎn wàngjì dài dōngxi!
dict.en: I almost forgot to bring my stuff!

dict.py: Wǒ wǔ fēnzhōng yǐhòu chūmén.
dict.en: I'm out the door in five minutes.

pass.zh: 喂，Eric，起床了沒？今天的大日子欸！伴手禮記得帶，七點二十高鐵站見。不要遲到喔！

qs.q: What must Eric remember to bring?
Where and when do they meet?

dict.py: Wǒ de wèizi kào chuānghù.
dict.en: My seat is by the window.

dict.py: Chuānghù wàimiàn de fēngjǐng zhēn měi.
dict.en: The scenery outside the window is gorgeous.

dict.py: Wǒ kànzhe kànzhe jiù shuìzháo le.
dict.en: I watched and watched and drifted off.

dict.py: Dào zhàn yǐqián jìdé jiàoxǐng wǒ.
dict.en: Remember to wake me before our stop.

dict.py: Kuài dào Zuǒyíng le, qǐlái ba!
dict.en: Almost at Zuoying — up you get!

pass.zh: 哈哈，你剛剛睡得超熟，還差一點坐過站！還好我叫醒你。快到了，東西收一收，準備下車囉！

ch: He nearly slept past the station
Pack up and get ready to alight

dict.py: Wǒmen dǐdá Zuǒyíng zhàn le.
dict.en: We've arrived at Zuoying station.

dict.py: Xiān chá yíxià jiéyùn lùxiàn.
dict.en: Check the MRT route first.

dict.py: Yào zài Měilìdǎo zhàn zhuǎnchē.
dict.en: We transfer at Formosa Boulevard.

dict.py: Gāoxióng bǐ Táiběi mēnrè duō le.
dict.en: Kaohsiung is way muggier than Taipei.

dict.zh: 我們提前二十分鐘到了。
dict.py: Wǒmen tíqián èrshí fēnzhōng dào le.
dict.en: We arrived twenty minutes early.

pass.zh: 各位旅客您好，本列車即將抵達左營站。要轉乘捷運的旅客，請走二號出口；轉乘台鐵請走一號出口。下車時請記得隨身物品，謝謝！

qs.q: Which exit for the MRT transfer?
Which exit for the regular railway (台鐵)?

dict.py: Huìyì jiǔ diǎn wǔshí kāichǎng.
dict.en: The meeting opens at 9:50.

dict.zh: 簡報的流程跟練習的一樣。
dict.py: Jiǎnbào de liúchéng gēn liànxí de yíyàng.
dict.en: The presentation flow is exactly as rehearsed.

dict.zh: 董事長提問的時候，不要緊張。
dict.py: Dǒngshìzhǎng tíwèn de shíhòu, búyào jǐnzhāng.
dict.en: When the chairman asks his question, stay calm.

dict.zh: 售後服務的問題由你掌握。
dict.py: Shòuhòu fúwù de wèntí yóu nǐ zhǎngwò.
dict.en: The after-sales question is yours to command.

dict.py: Shēnhūxī, wǒmen shàngchǎng le.
dict.en: Deep breath — we're on.

pass.zh: Eric，最後三分鐘提醒：開場先交換名片、送伴手禮；流程照練習的走，你講產品，我講價格。董事長提問，售後服務的部分由你回答。放輕鬆，我們準備得很完整。上場！

dict.zh: 高雄正從重工業轉型成科技城市。
dict.py: Gāoxióng zhèng cóng zhòng gōngyè zhuǎnxíng chéng kējì chéngshì.
dict.en: Kaohsiung is transforming from heavy industry into a tech city.

dict.zh: 越來越多企業進駐科技園區。
dict.py: Yuèláiyuè duō qìyè jìnzhù kējì yuánqū.
dict.en: More and more companies are moving into the tech parks.

dict.zh: 半導體大廠紛紛在南部布局。
dict.py: Bàndǎotǐ dàchǎng fēnfēn zài nánbù bùjú.
dict.en: Semiconductor giants are staking out the south one after another.

dict.zh: 專家指出，住宅與人才是新的壓力。
dict.py: Zhuānjiā zhǐchū, zhùzhái yǔ réncái shì xīn de yālì.
dict.en: Experts note housing and talent are the new pressures.

dict.zh: 政府將加強在地人才培育。
dict.py: Zhèngfǔ jiāng jiāqiáng zàidì réncái péiyù.
dict.en: The government will strengthen local talent cultivation.

pass.zh: 產業新聞：高雄的轉型正在加速，科技園區吸引半導體、無人機與綠能業者進駐，外銷表現亮眼。不過專家指出，住宅價格上漲與人才供給不足，是轉型的兩大挑戰；政府表示將加強在地培育，讓南方的成長走得更穩。

qs.q: Which industries are moving into the parks?
What are the two big transformation challenges?
ch: Rising housing prices and talent shortfall
Steady the transformation via local talent cultivation

scenarios.intro: Seven minutes before muster, one convenience store between you and the platform. Coffee, a rice ball, heat it, go.

them.zh: 歡迎光臨！
them.py: Huānyíng guānglín!
them.en: Welcome!

turns.task: Order a hot coffee — a big one.

ans.zh: 你好，我要一杯熱咖啡，大杯的。
ans.py: Nǐ hǎo, wǒ yào yì bēi rè kāfēi, dà bēi de.
ans.en: Hi — a hot coffee, large.

them.zh: 好的！還需要什麼嗎？
them.py: Hǎo de! Hái xūyào shénme ma?
them.en: Sure! Anything else?

turns.task: Add a rice ball (飯糰) — and ask them to heat it up.

ans.zh: 再一個飯糰，麻煩幫我加熱。
ans.py: Zài yíge fàntuán, máfán bāng wǒ jiārè.
ans.en: A rice ball too — heated, please.

them.zh: 沒問題。一共九十五塊。
them.py: Méi wèntí. Yígòng jiǔshíwǔ kuài.
them.en: No problem — 95 total.

turns.task: Pay with your EasyCard.

ans.zh: 我用悠遊卡，謝謝。
ans.py: Wǒ yòng Yōuyóukǎ, xièxie.
ans.en: EasyCard, thanks.

them.zh: 好了！小心燙喔！
them.py: Hǎo le! Xiǎoxīn tàng o!
them.en: All set! Careful, it's hot!

turns.task: Thank them — you're in a hurry to catch the train!

ans.zh: 謝謝！我趕車，先走了！
ans.py: Xièxie! Wǒ gǎn chē, xiān zǒu le!
ans.en: Thanks! Racing for a train — gotta run!

them.zh: 祝你順利喔！掰掰！
them.py: Zhù nǐ shùnlì o! Bāibāi!
them.en: Good luck out there! Bye!

turns.task: Today you'll need it — thanks, bye!

ans.zh: 今天真的需要，謝謝！掰掰！
ans.py: Jīntiān zhēnde xūyào, xièxie! Bāibāi!
ans.en: Today I really will — thanks! Bye!

scenarios.who: 同事小陳 Coworker Xiao Chen
scenarios.intro: Ninety minutes to Zuoying. Trade a little honesty about nerves, set the wake-up deal, and let the west coast slide by.

them.zh: 呼，趕上了！欸，你會緊張嗎？
them.py: Hū, gǎnshàng le! Éi, nǐ huì jǐnzhāng ma?
them.en: Phew, made it! Hey — you nervous?

turns.task: Be honest: a little — but you practiced a lot, so mostly ready.

ans.zh: 有一點，可是我們練習了很多次，準備好了。
ans.py: Yǒu yìdiǎn, kěshì wǒmen liànxí le hěnduō cì, zhǔnbèi hǎo le.
ans.en: A little — but we've drilled it plenty. We're ready.

them.zh: 對啊，放輕鬆。你看窗戶外面，天氣超好。
them.py: Duì a, fàng qīngsōng. Nǐ kàn chuānghù wàimiàn, tiānqì chāo hǎo.
them.en: Right — relax. Look out the window, gorgeous day.

turns.task: Agree — say the scenery is beautiful; a good sign!

ans.zh: 真的，風景好美，是好兆頭！
ans.py: Zhēnde, fēngjǐng hǎo měi, shì hǎo zhàotóu!
ans.en: Really is — beautiful. A good omen!

them.zh: 哈哈！你先瞇一下吧，昨天一定沒睡好。
them.py: Hāhā! Nǐ xiān mī yíxià ba, zuótiān yídìng méi shuì hǎo.
them.en: Haha! Grab a nap — you definitely didn't sleep well.

turns.task: Take the offer — but make him promise to wake you before arrival.

ans.zh: 好，可是到站以前一定要叫醒我喔！
ans.py: Hǎo, kěshì dào zhàn yǐqián yídìng yào jiàoxǐng wǒ o!
ans.en: Deal — but you MUST wake me before we arrive!

them.zh: 放心啦！（九十分鐘後）欸欸，快到左營了！
them.py: Fàngxīn la! (jiǔshí fēnzhōng hòu) Éi éi, kuài dào Zuǒyíng le!
them.en: Don't worry! (ninety minutes later) Hey hey — almost Zuoying!

turns.task: Wake up confused — you fell asleep the moment you looked at the scenery!

ans.zh: 蛤？我看著風景就睡著了！
ans.py: Há? Wǒ kànzhe fēngjǐng jiù shuìzháo le!
ans.en: Huh? I watched the scenery straight into a coma!

them.zh: 哈哈，走吧，大日子開始了！
them.py: Hāhā, zǒu ba, dà rìzi kāishǐ le!
them.en: Haha, let's move — the big day begins!

turns.task: Rally: grab the gift, let's go win this!

ans.zh: 走！拿好伴手禮，我們去把案子拿下來！
ans.py: Zǒu! Ná hǎo bànshǒulǐ, wǒmen qù bǎ ànzi ná xiàlái!
ans.en: Let's go! Gift in hand — let's land this deal!

scenarios.intro: Out of the HSR, into an unfamiliar MRT map, twenty minutes of buffer. Get the route, the transfer, and the timing — no wrong turns today.

them.zh: 您好，需要幫忙嗎？
them.py: Nín hǎo, xūyào bāngmáng ma?
them.en: Hello — can I help you?

turns.task: Ask how to get to the software park (軟體園區) by MRT.

ans.zh: 你好，請問搭捷運到軟體園區怎麼走？
ans.py: Nǐ hǎo, qǐngwèn dā jiéyùn dào ruǎntǐ yuánqū zěnme zǒu?
ans.en: Hi — how do I get to the software park by MRT?

them.zh: 搭紅線，在美麗島站轉橘線。
them.py: Dā hóng xiàn, zài Měilìdǎo zhàn zhuǎn jú xiàn.
them.en: Red line, transfer to the orange line at Formosa Boulevard.

turns.task: Repeat the route back to confirm: red line, transfer at 美麗島 to orange.

ans.zh: 紅線，美麗島站轉橘線，對嗎？
ans.py: Hóng xiàn, Měilìdǎo zhàn zhuǎn jú xiàn, duì ma?
ans.en: Red line, orange at Formosa Boulevard — correct?

them.zh: 對！全程大概二十五分鐘。
them.py: Duì! Quánchéng dàgài èrshíwǔ fēnzhōng.
them.en: Right! About 25 minutes total.

turns.task: Your meeting is at 9:50 — ask if that timing is tight from here.

ans.zh: 我們的會議九點五十開始，現在出發時間會不會太趕？
ans.py: Wǒmen de huìyì jiǔ diǎn wǔshí kāishǐ, xiànzài chūfā shíjiān huì bú huì tài gǎn?
ans.en: Our meeting's at 9:50 — is leaving now cutting it too close?

them.zh: 現在九點，來得及，不過要直接走，不要逛喔。
them.py: Xiànzài jiǔ diǎn, láidejí, búguò yào zhíjiē zǒu, búyào guàng o.
them.en: It's nine now — you'll make it, but go straight there, no wandering.

turns.task: Got it — go straight there; ask which exit for the red line.

ans.zh: 了解，我們直接走。請問紅線從幾號出口？
ans.py: Liǎojiě, wǒmen zhíjiē zǒu. Qǐngwèn hóng xiàn cóng jǐ hào chūkǒu?
ans.en: Understood, straight there. Which exit for the red line?

them.zh: 二號出口下樓就是。祝你們開會順利！
them.py: Èr hào chūkǒu xià lóu jiùshì. Zhù nǐmen kāihuì shùnlì!
them.en: Exit two, straight downstairs. Good luck with your meeting!

turns.task: Thank them — today's a big one!

ans.zh: 謝謝你！今天是我們的大日子！
ans.py: Xièxie nǐ! Jīntiān shì wǒmen de dà rìzi!
ans.en: Thank you — today's our big day!

scenarios.en: Face to Face with the Chairman
scenarios.intro: The room goes quiet when he speaks. Open with respect, field THE question — the one you drilled — and close the deal window he opens. Boss-register Mandarin, live.

them.zh: 歡迎歡迎！遠道而來，辛苦了。
them.py: Huānyíng huānyíng! Yuǎndào ér lái, xīnkǔ le.
them.en: Welcome, welcome! You've come a long way.

turns.task: Present the gift with the formula — a small token, please accept it — and say meeting him is an honor.

ans.zh: 董事長您好！這是我們的一點小心意，請笑納。能見到您是我們的榮幸。
ans.py: Dǒngshìzhǎng nín hǎo! Zhè shì wǒmen de yìdiǎn xiǎo xīnyì, qǐng xiàonà. Néng jiàndào nín shì wǒmen de róngxìng.
ans.en: Chairman, hello! A small token of our appreciation — please accept it. Meeting you is our honor.

them.zh: 太客氣了！坐坐坐。聽說你們的測試飛了三十分鐘？
them.py: Tài kèqì le! Zuò zuò zuò. Tīngshuō nǐmen de cèshì fēi le sānshí fēnzhōng?
them.en: Too kind! Sit, sit. I hear your test flew thirty minutes?

turns.task: Confirm — thirty minutes in real conditions; the full data is in today's presentation.

ans.zh: 是的，在真實環境飛了三十分鐘，完整的數據都在今天的簡報裡。
ans.py: Shì de, zài zhēnshí huánjìng fēi le sānshí fēnzhōng, wánzhěng de shùjù dōu zài jīntiān de jiǎnbào lǐ.
ans.en: Yes — thirty minutes in real conditions. The full data is in today's presentation.

them.zh: （簡報後）我最關心一件事：機器壞了，你們多快能處理？
them.py: (jiǎnbào hòu) Wǒ zuì guānxīn yí jiàn shì: jīqì huài le, nǐmen duō kuài néng chǔlǐ?
them.en: (after the pitch) My one concern: when a unit fails, how fast do you respond?

turns.task: THE drilled answer: reply within 24 hours, technician on site within 48; critical parts stocked in Taiwan.

ans.zh: 我們二十四小時內回覆，四十八小時內工程師到現場，重要的零件都在台灣有庫存。
ans.py: Wǒmen èrshísì xiǎoshí nèi huífù, sìshíbā xiǎoshí nèi gōngchéngshī dào xiànchǎng, zhòngyào de língjiàn dōu zài Táiwān yǒu kùcún.
ans.en: We reply within 24 hours, engineer on site within 48 — and critical parts are stocked in Taiwan.

turns.keys: 二十四四十八零件庫存

them.zh: 好，這個答案我滿意。我們也希望這不只是一筆生意。
them.py: Hǎo, zhège dá'àn wǒ mǎnyì. Wǒmen yě xīwàng zhè bù zhǐshì yì bǐ shēngyì.
them.en: Good — that answer satisfies me. And we hope this is more than one transaction.

turns.task: Match his register: your company also hopes for long-term cooperation — this order is just the beginning.

ans.zh: 我們也是。希望建立長期合作的關係，這筆訂單只是開始。
ans.py: Wǒmen yě shì. Xīwàng jiànlì chángqí hézuò de guānxì, zhè bǐ dìngdān zhǐshì kāishǐ.
ans.en: So do we — we hope to build long-term cooperation. This order is only the beginning.

them.zh: 很好。下個月簽約，就在高雄。中午別走，嚐嚐我們的海鮮！
them.py: Hěn hǎo. Xià ge yuè qiānyuē, jiù zài Gāoxióng. Zhōngwǔ bié zǒu, chángcháng wǒmen de hǎixiān!
them.en: Excellent. We sign next month, right here in Kaohsiung. And stay for lunch — try our seafood!

turns.task: Accept both with gratitude: next month it is, and you've long heard Kaohsiung's seafood is the best.

ans.zh: 一言為定，下個月高雄見！海鮮我們久仰大名，謝謝董事長招待！
ans.py: Yì yán wéi dìng, xià ge yuè Gāoxióng jiàn! Hǎixiān wǒmen jiǔyǎng dàmíng, xièxie dǒngshìzhǎng zhāodài!
ans.en: It's a deal — next month in Kaohsiung! And your seafood's fame precedes it — thank you, Chairman!

scenarios.intro: Fresh off the southbound train: argue whether Kaohsiung's transformation is real, weigh its growing pains, and place your own deal inside the bigger map.

them.zh: 你今天剛從高雄回來。你覺得「南方崛起」是真的，還是口號？
them.py: Nǐ jīntiān gāng cóng Gāoxióng huílái. Nǐ juéde 'nánfāng juéqǐ' shì zhēn de, háishì kǒuhào?
them.en: You're just back from Kaohsiung. Is the 'rise of the south' real, or a slogan?

turns.task: Real — the evidence: semiconductor giants laying out southward, companies moving into the parks, exports shining.

ans.zh: 我認為是真的。證據很清楚：半導體大廠在南部布局，企業紛紛進駐園區，外銷表現也很亮眼。
ans.py: Wǒ rènwéi shì zhēn de. Zhèngjù hěn qīngchǔ: bàndǎotǐ dàchǎng zài nánbù bùjú, qìyè fēnfēn jìnzhù yuánqū, wàixiāo biǎoxiàn yě hěn liàngyǎn.
ans.en: It's real. The evidence is clear: semiconductor giants staking out the south, firms moving into the parks, and export numbers shining.

them.zh: 轉型會不會只是把台北的問題搬到高雄？
them.py: Zhuǎnxíng huì bú huì zhǐshì bǎ Táiběi de wèntí bān dào Gāoxióng?
them.en: Might the transformation just move Taipei's problems to Kaohsiung?

turns.task: Concede the risk is real — housing prices and talent supply pressures are rising — but argue it's manageable if addressed early, unlike Taipei's late start.

ans.zh: 這個風險確實存在，住宅價格跟人才供給的壓力都在升高。但是高雄還來得及提早處理，這是台北當年沒有的機會。
ans.py: Zhège fēngxiǎn quèshí cúnzài, zhùzhái jiàgé gēn réncái gōngjǐ de yālì dōu zài shēnggāo. Dànshì Gāoxióng hái láidejí tízǎo chǔlǐ, zhè shì Táiběi dāngnián méiyǒu de jīhuì.
ans.en: The risk is real — housing and talent pressures are climbing. But Kaohsiung can still act early — a chance Taipei never had.

them.zh: 那要讓轉型走得穩，最關鍵的是什麼？
them.py: Nà yào ràng zhuǎnxíng zǒu de wěn, zuì guānjiàn de shì shénme?
them.en: What's most critical to keeping the transformation steady?

turns.task: Local talent cultivation — parks can be built in years, but engineers take a decade; universities and industry must connect now.

ans.zh: 在地人才培育。園區幾年就蓋得起來，工程師卻要十年養成，大學跟產業現在就要接起來。
ans.py: Zàidì réncái péiyù. Yuánqū jǐ nián jiù gài de qǐlái, gōngchéngshī què yào shí nián yǎngchéng, dàxué gēn chǎnyè xiànzài jiù yào jiē qǐlái.
ans.en: Local talent cultivation. You can build a park in a few years, but an engineer takes ten — universities and industry must connect now.

them.zh: 聽說你們今天也在高雄談成了一個案子？
them.py: Tīngshuō nǐmen jīntiān yě zài Gāoxióng tánchéng le yíge ànzi?
them.en: I hear you closed a deal in Kaohsiung today yourselves?

turns.task: Yes — place it in the map: a drone order signed next month in Kaohsiung; small piece, but exactly what the southern layout looks like company by company.

ans.zh: 對，我們的無人機案子下個月就在高雄簽約。規模不大，但是南方的布局，就是由一家一家公司這樣拼起來的。
ans.py: Duì, wǒmen de wúrénjī ànzi xià ge yuè jiù zài Gāoxióng qiānyuē. Guīmó bú dà, dànshì nánfāng de bùjú, jiùshì yóu yì jiā yì jiā gōngsī zhèyàng pīn qǐlái de.
ans.en: Yes — our drone deal signs next month in Kaohsiung. Small in scale, but the southern layout is assembled exactly this way, company by company.

them.zh: 「一家一家拼起來」，說得真好。恭喜，也謝謝你的分享！
them.py: 'Yì jiā yì jiā pīn qǐlái', shuō de zhēn hǎo. Gōngxǐ, yě xièxie nǐ de fēnxiǎng!
them.en: 'Assembled company by company' — well put. Congratulations, and thanks for sharing!

turns.task: Thank the host — and admit you're rushing off to a victory KTV where you've been ordered to sing.

ans.zh: 謝謝主持人！我要先走了——慶功KTV在等我，主管規定我一定要唱歌！
ans.py: Xièxie zhǔchírén! Wǒ yào xiān zǒu le — qìnggōng KTV zài děng wǒ, zhǔguǎn guīdìng wǒ yídìng yào chànggē!
ans.en: Thanks! I have to run — the victory KTV awaits, and the boss has decreed that I sing!

x: Wǒ shè le sān ge nàozhōng.
vocab.n: 鬧 = noisy + 鐘 clock. 設鬧鐘 = set an alarm; 按掉 = snooze it (the national sport).

x: Míngtiān yào zǎoqǐ, zǎodiǎn shuì ba.
vocab.n: 早起的鳥兒有蟲吃 — the early bird gets the worm, same proverb.
The check-in verb: 你出門了嗎？ Also 出門在外 = when you're away from home.
別忘記/別忘了 = don't forget. Pairs beautifully with Day 9's 差點.

x: Qǐng bāng wǒ kāi yíxià chuānghù.
Please open the window for me.
vocab.n: The physical window; 靠窗 = window-side (seats), 窗外 = outside the window.

x: Wǒ zuótiān shí'èr diǎn cái shuìzháo.
I didn't fall asleep until midnight.
vocab.n: 著 zháo marks success: 睡著 managed to sleep, 睡不著 can't fall asleep — insomnia's word.
叫 call + 醒 awake. Hotel wake-up call = 晨喚服務 — but everyone just says 叫醒.

vocab.e: to lean on; next to; to rely on
x: Wǒ yào kào chuāng de wèizi.
vocab.n: Physical (靠窗) and metaphorical (靠你了 — counting on you). Alone as an exclamation it's rude — mind the context.
Announcement/news register for 到. 即將抵達 = now arriving — every MRT and HSR broadcast.

x: Xiān chá hǎo lùxiàn zài chūfā.
Check the route before setting out.
vocab.n: Transit routes, hiking trails, and political 路線 (party line) — plus flight paths in your world.
轉乘 zhuǎnchéng is the formal announcement version of the same act.

x: It gets extra muggy before a typhoon.
vocab.n: 悶 = stuffy/airless. The precise word for southern-Taiwan summer — 熱 alone doesn't cover the humidity.
開場白 = opening remarks — prepare yours before any 簡報.
The formal Q of Q&A; casual asking is just 問. 開放提問 = the floor is open.

vocab.e: to grasp, command, have control of
vocab.n: 掌 = palm: to hold in your hand. 掌握狀況 = have situational awareness — mil/ops crossover gold.

x: 我們先確認今天的流程。
Wǒmen xiān quèrèn jīntiān de liúchéng.
vocab.n: SOP 的核心字：作業流程 = operating procedure, 流程圖 = flowchart. Engineering meetings live here.

x: 傳統產業正在數位轉型。
vocab.n: 數位轉型 (digital transformation) is the buzzword of the decade in every Taiwanese boardroom.

x: The Hsinchu Science Park is famous.
vocab.n: 竹科 (Hsinchu), 南科 (Tainan) — the abbreviations that move Taiwan's economy. Your industry's habitat.

vocab.e: to move in, establish presence, station
x: 越來越多外商進駐台灣。
More and more foreign firms are setting up in Taiwan.
vocab.n: Companies 進駐 parks; troops 進駐 positions — the same verb serves business pages and defense news.

x: 這家公司提早布局東南亞市場。
Zhè jiā gōngsī tízǎo bùjú Dōngnányà shìchǎng.
The firm positioned early in Southeast Asia.
vocab.n: From chess/Go: arranging the board. 全球布局 global footprint, 戰略布局 strategic posture — DLPT-grade vocabulary.

x: 我透早五點半就起來了！
Wǒ thàu-tsá wǔ diǎn bàn jiù qǐlái le!
I was up at five-thirty, crack of dawn!
slang.n: Hokkien for 一大早. 透早的市場 — the dawn market — is where the real Taiwan wakes up.

slang.e: go go go! full speed ahead
x: Dà rìzi dào le, chōng chōng chōng!
The big day is here — go go go!
slang.n: Taiwan hype-chant, tripled for maximum momentum. Politicians, sports fans, and sales teams all run on it.

x: Yí shàng gāotiě wǒ jiù miǎoshuì.
The second I boarded the HSR, I was out.
slang.n: Internet-era 秒+verb pattern (both sides of the strait): 秒睡 instant sleep, 秒回 instant reply, 秒殺 sold out instantly.

x: 小陳根本神隊友，什麼都想到了。
Xiǎo Chén gēnběn shénduìyǒu, shénme dōu xiǎngdào le.
Xiao Chen is an absolute MVP — thought of everything.
slang.n: Taiwan gaming-to-office slang. Opposite: 豬隊友 (pig teammate) — the one who drags everyone down.

x: 在高鐵上打呼被聽到，真的社死。
Zài gāotiě shàng dǎhū bèi tīngdào, zhēnde shèsǐ.
Getting caught snoring on the HSR — actual social death.
slang.n: Mainland internet (社會性死亡 shortened), now current in Taiwan. For moments you wish witness protection existed.
